items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: So, we went to work, an' me an' Billie Holiday used to get into a fight all the time... So me an' Pete Johnson showed up so they got used to usin' two pianos... and we...uh, got together with them and made a team out of it.

ctx.x: Pete Johnson, Albert Ammons and Meade Lux Lewis, and, uh... 'Course I met them away late.
